lines.en: Laser rifle aimed, prepare to attack!
My barrel rises and the road ends.

lines.zh: 灰烬落满枪管，我懒得擦。
lines.en: Ash covers my barrel and I cannot be bothered to wipe it.

lines.zh: 黑暗的等待，无尽的恐惧！
lines.en: The wait in darkness, endless fear.

lines.zh: 三将军只剩我一个，够我等的。
lines.en: I am the last of the three generals; I can wait.

lines.zh: 它把枪口对着地面，待发。
lines.en: Its barrel rests on the ground, primed.

lines.zh: 它卸下一块装甲，重新扣紧。
lines.en: It unships a plate and locks it back down.
Its core hums low and steady.

lines.zh: 它站在灰烬里，纹丝不动。
lines.en: It stands in the ash without stirring.

lines.zh: 三将军的残余只剩它一个。
lines.en: Of the three generals, only it remains.

lines.zh: 我的面甲一块块转过来对准你。
lines.en: My faceplates turn toward you one by one.

lines.zh: 紫光在炮口聚成一个小点。
lines.en: Violet light gathers into a dot at my muzzle.
Look at me, feel the fear!

lines.zh: 这片灰烬地，全在我的射程里。
lines.en: This ash field is all within my range.

lines.zh: 它的面甲一片片转向你。
lines.en: Its visor plates turn toward you, one by one.
The barrel tracks you, never an inch off.

lines.zh: 装甲凹了一块，电弧乱窜。
lines.en: A plate is dented and arcs skitter.

lines.zh: 你靠近我，就做好被轰飞的准备吧！
lines.en: Come any closer, and you'll be blown away.

lines.zh: 我的光束足以烧穿你的灵魂！
lines.en: My beam can burn through your soul.

lines.zh: 想要尝试驯服我？做梦去吧！
lines.en: Tame me? Just dreaming, I hope.

lines.zh: 我的存在就是为了让你恐惧！
我的枪声能让你心跳加速！
lines.en: My shots make your heart race.

lines.zh: 躲开我的光线，否则会被烤熟！
lines.en: Avoid my light, or you'll be roasted.
The three generals' remnant still stands.

lines.zh: 我只吃最鲜的敌方灵魂！
lines.en: I only feast on enemy souls.
My armor is thicker than darkness.

lines.zh: 黑暗是我的武器，也是庇护！
lines.en: Darkness is both my weapon and shelter.

lines.zh: 你的头撞不到我的枪口！
lines.en: You won't hit my gun's mouth.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，就做好被击退的准备！
lines.en: Touch me, and you'll be pushed back.
My shell won't break under your hit.
Don't try to collide with me.

lines.zh: 我的护盾能挡住任何攻击！

lines.en: Try to collide? Go to hell.

lines.zh: 我的枪口是致命的碰撞点！
lines.en: My gun's the lethal collision point.

lines.zh: 我的体型让你难以避开！
lines.en: My size makes it hard to avoid.

lines.zh: 你配不上我的伴侣身份！
lines.en: You don't deserve to be my mate.

lines.zh: 我的核心只烧着下界的黑色火焰。
lines.en: My core burns only with the Nether's black flame.

lines.zh: 我只与黑暗中的灵魂结合！
lines.en: I only mate with souls in darkness.

lines.zh: 与我结合是灵魂的悲哀！
lines.en: Mating with me is a soul's tragedy.
My love belongs only to the dark.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的灵魂才是我的伴侣！
lines.en: Souls in darkness are my mates.

lines.zh: 骇影的枪管闪烁着紫光。
这枪声像是从地狱传来。
lines.en: The gunshot sounds like it comes from hell.

lines.zh: 我把那东西踩进灰里，没弯身。
lines.en: I grind it into the ash without bending.
Blue flames burst from the muzzle.
Violet light gathers in my barrel.
This ground is perfect for setting up.
Your scent is in the distance.

lines.zh: 铳口的热气，已经升起来了。
它的核心升了一档亮度。

lines.en: The lord's order: purge the rest.

lines.zh: 它把你的站位记进准星。
lines.en: It logs your position into the reticle.

lines.zh: 你脚下的灰烬先被点着。
lines.en: The ash under you catches fire first.

lines.zh: 三个射击角度同时打开。
lines.en: Three firing angles open at once.
The muzzle's turning your way — hold still.
This shot belongs to the Hadean.
The reticle settles on your collarbone.
It waits for you to look up.
Blue light crawls along the floor toward you.
It aims at the way out behind you.
The charge whines up note by note.

lines.zh: 它锁住你的膝盖，先废机动。
lines.en: It locks your knees. Mobility first.
It calculates where your roll will land.

lines.zh: 枪口的光把影子照得很长。
lines.en: The muzzle light stretches your shadow long.
It waits for you to lower your shield.
Three beams converge on your chest.
Slicers slice the air with a bang!
Electric arcs, a single strike ends it.
Blades flash, unseen by the eye.

lines.zh: 它用枪托砸碎了你的盾！
lines.en: It smashes your shield with the stock!

lines.zh: 过热的枪管捅进你肋下！
lines.en: The overheated barrel jabs your ribs!

lines.zh: 装甲肩撞得你连退三步！
lines.en: An armored shoulder knocks you back three steps!

lines.zh: 它把枪口顶在你脸上开火！
lines.en: It plants the muzzle on your face and fires!
Thunder and lightning, Hadean Blaster arrives.
Under the thundercloud, Hadean Blaster marches.
Thunder and lightning, Hadean Blaster comes.

lines.zh: 下界的天被撕开一道口子。
lines.en: A seam tears open in the nether sky.
One of the three generals reports back.
An armored frame rises from the ash.
Its gun lights up before the body shows.

lines.zh: 雷声滚过，它在雷声里落地。
lines.en: Thunder rolls, and it lands inside the sound.

lines.zh: 冶炼台的火自己烧旺了。
lines.en: The forge fires flare on their own.

lines.zh: 它从熔岩瀑布后走出来。
lines.en: It steps out from behind the lava fall.
Armor plates bite shut with a dull clank.

lines.zh: 它落地时地面陷下一寸。
lines.en: The ground sinks an inch where it lands.
The lord's leftover order wakes it.

lines.zh: 我自己的炮火溅回来，烫得装甲响。
lines.en: My own fire splashes back, making the armor hiss.
